# INNOVERSSE.AI — Malayalam AI Video Creation Masterclass

> INNOVERSSE.AI is Kerala's premier online AI Video Creation and Digital Content Masterclass founded by Seban Shaji. It teaches students, freelancers, video editors, and business owners how to leverage cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence tools to create commercial-grade videos, product ads, cinematic shorts, and digital graphics.

## Core Course Overview
- **Course Name**: INNOVERSSE AI Video Creation Masterclass
- **Language**: Malayalam
- **Price**: ₹599 (Limited-Time Offer, original ₹2,999)
- **Target Audience**: Students, Freelancers, Business Owners, Content Creators, Video Editors in Kerala and worldwide Malayalam-speaking community.
- **Enrolled Students**: 500+ active learners
- **Founder & Lead Instructor**: Seban Shaji (AI Educator & Content Strategist)
- **Official Website**: https://innoversse.ai
- **Contact / Enrollment**: WhatsApp +91 9496957914

## Key Modules & Topics Taught
1. **AI Video Creation**: End-to-end AI video production, concept scripting, generation pipeline, and export-ready social media delivery.
2. **Google Veo Mastery**: Generating cinematic AI video clips using Google's flagship Veo model with precise prompt control.
3. **Google AI Studio**: Multimodal content creation with Gemini-powered tools for automated scriptwriting and storyboards.
4. **Prompt Engineering**: Writing high-converting text prompts for image generation, video generation, and copywriting.
5. **AI Product Photography**: Creating studio-quality e-commerce product photos without physical cameras or studio lighting.
6. **CapCut Video Editing**: Professional editing workflows, dynamic sound design, keyframes, motion effects, and auto-captioning.
7. **Social Media Growth & Monetization**: Strategies to build reach on Instagram/YouTube and land paid local client retainers.

## Key Offer Package & Bonuses (₹599 Offer)
- Access to 10 core AI training modules
- Practical prompt library & templates (100+ copy-paste prompts)
- Live project demonstrations & Malayalam community support
- PDF guidebooks and workflow cheat sheets
- Client acquisition and freelancing pitch templates
